label: Real run on this Mac's Docker Compose stack, with synthetic traffic from klaxon.traffic and one fault from klaxon.faults injected on purpose (synthetic data, a simulated provider, no real money). It records what the fault looks like from the outside; it is not the Klaxon agent.

fault.name: poison-message
fault.title: The ledger stops booking: a poison message
fault.cause: a deploy of the ledger consumer that retries unreadable messages forever (BAD_EVENTS=retry), then one unreadable event from the provider (a payment.updated with its amount as a decimal string): the ledger consumer is stuck on it, and books nothing behind it
expected_symptoms: the ledger's lag climbs on every partition: one consumer reads all three, and it is stuck on that one message (head-of-line blocking); the payment confirmer keeps up
the ledger's retries climb, with 'could not book; will retry the same message' errors for one offset
the confirmer dead-letters the same event as unreadable; the ledger never does
the ledger consumer turns unhealthy: its heartbeat stops while it retries
the money check cannot settle (exit 2); without waiting, the events behind the poison look lost
fault.remedy: roll the ledger consumer back to dead-lettering: the poison goes to the dead-letter topic, the backlog drains, and the money check passes again

findings: not settled up to the cutoff after 20.16 s: messages up to it not handled yet: ledger 210, payment-confirmer 0
